title: Nutritional Balance and Disease Resistance in Aquatic Organisms
summary: This cluster focuses on the nutritional balance and disease resistance in aquatic organisms. Taurine has evidence for its benefits in several fish species, including European seabass, Gilthead seabream, Olive flounder, and Red seabream. Phosphorus has evidence for its relationship with Phytase. Fishmeal is a source of DHA and EPA. The organisms Olive flounder, Red seabream, and Whiteleg shrimp are hosts to Vibrio parahaemolyticus, which is challenged by Disease Resistance. Nutritional Equivalence is required for stress, and Digestibility is a process related to the nutritional balance of aquatic organisms.
